title: Identification of PIK3R5 as a hub in septic myocardial injury and the cardioprotective effects of Psoralidin.
authors: Wang, Xue; Liang, Zhenxing; Liu, Qiong; Ye, Xingyan; Wu, Xue; Deng, Chao; Zhao, Lin; Lu, Chenxi; Qiu, Zhenye; Yao, Yu; Yang, Yang; Xu, Xuezeng
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究脓毒症心肌损伤中Psoralidin的心脏保护作用及PIK3R5枢纽基因，核心为疾病机制与药物靶点，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Myocardial injury is a severe complication of sepsis, resulting in substantial morbidity and mortality. Psoralidin (PSO), derived from the seeds of Psoralea corylifolia L., has garnered considerable attention due to its potent pharmacological effects, including anti-inflammatory and antibacterial effects. PURPOSE: Our previous work conducted affirmed that PSO has a protective effect on sepsis and septic myocardial injury, however the specific molecular mechanisms need further clarification. STUDY DESIGN: This objective of this study was to use three analytic modalities and bioinformatics methods to identify potential targets, followed by experimental verification. METHODS: A series of experiments methods (including echocardiography, HE, western blot, qPCR, RNA-seq, network pharmacology) were used to evaluate the effects of PSO against sepsis and septic myocardial injury in cecal ligation and puncture (CLP)-injured BALB/c mice and lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-injured HL-1 cardiomyocytes. RESULTS: Firstly, a group of sepsis-related genes were identified by integrating database surveys, RNA-seq analysis, and weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WCGNA). Subsequently, the pharmacological targets of PSO were predicted. Furthermore, the identification of phosphoinositide 3- kinase regulatory subunit 5 (PIK3R5) as a crucial hub gene was accomplished via protein-protein interaction network and molecular docking approach. In vivo experiments showed that PSO treatment alleviated septic myocardial injury, as evidenced by improved cardiac function indicators and inflammation response. Similar results were obtained in vitro experiments. Importantly, the expression of PI3KR5 was decreased in the myocardium and cardiomyocytes, and the effect was reversed by PSO treatment. CONCLUSION: This study systematically revealed the key targets of PSO in the treatment of septic myocardial injury. These findings offer valuable insights into disease-drug targets, which have certain clinical significance to exploring disease biomarkers and potential therapeutic targets for septic patients.
abstract_zh: 背景：心肌损伤是脓毒症的严重并发症，导致显著的发病率和死亡率。补骨脂酚 (Psoralidin, PSO) 源自补骨脂 (Psoralea corylifolia L.) 的种子，因其强效的药理作用（包括抗炎和抗菌作用）而受到广泛关注。目的：我们先前的工作已证实PSO对脓毒症及脓毒性心肌损伤具有保护作用，但其具体分子机制需进一步阐明。研究设计：本研究旨在利用三种分析模式和生物信息学方法识别潜在靶点，随后进行实验验证。方法：采用一系列实验方法（包括超声心动图、HE染色、western blot、qPCR、RNA-seq、网络药理学）评估PSO对盲肠结扎穿刺 (cecal ligation and puncture, CLP) 损伤的BALB/c小鼠和脂多糖 (lipopolysaccharide, LPS) 损伤的HL-1心肌细胞中脓毒症及脓毒性心肌损伤的作用。结果：首先，通过整合数据库调查、RNA-seq分析和加权基因共表达网络分析 (weighted gene co-expression network analysis, WGCNA) 识别了一组脓毒症相关基因。随后，预测了PSO的药理靶点。此外，通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络和分子对接方法，鉴定出磷酸肌醇3-激酶调节亚基5 (phosphoinositide 3-kinase regulatory subunit 5, PIK3R5) 为关键枢纽基因。体内实验表明，PSO治疗减轻了脓毒性心肌损伤，表现为心脏功能指标和炎症反应的改善。体外实验获得了类似结果。重要的是，PIK3R5在心肌和心肌细胞中的表达降低，而PSO治疗逆转了这一效应。结论：本研究系统揭示了PSO治疗脓毒性心肌损伤的关键靶点。这些发现为疾病-药物靶点提供了有价值的见解，对探索脓毒症患者的疾病生物标志物和潜在治疗靶点具有一定的临床意义。
